selection: Roll a D6 to pick one of the six pools, then a D6 re-rolling 5s and 6s to pick one of its four scenarios (numbered 1-4 in pool order); a pool already used in the event cannot come up again until every pool has been used, and no scenario repeats.

commonRules.name: Maelstrom of Battle
commonRules.summary: Nobody deploys; agree which edge is north. At the end of your Move Phase roll a D6 per off-board Warband (Captain may use Might), one at a time: 1 not yet; 2 opponent picks a north/south edge point; 3 opponent picks an east/west point; 4 you pick north/south; 5 you pick east/west; 6 you pick any edge. Points must be at least 6" from a corner; entry uses Reinforcements. Off-board Warbands count as on the board for Broken.

commonRules.name: Dark of Night
commonRules.summary: The game is played under the Fighting at Night rules from the core rules manual (p.137).

commonRules.name: A Time of Heroes
commonRules.summary: Whenever your side kills an enemy Hero in a Fight, one of your Heroes in that Fight regains 1 spent Might (not above its starting value).

commonRules.name: Heirloom of Power
commonRules.summary: An Heirloom is a Light Object that cannot be dropped or handed over; before Priority each turn roll a D6 per carried Heirloom and its holder is Transfixed on a 1. Warriors may carry only one Heirloom, Heroes any number.

commonRules.name: Uncovering Artefacts
commonRules.summary: An Infantry model touching an objective at the end of its move may take an Intelligence test (no Might) to free the Artefact and pick it up as a Light Object; one attempt per side per Artefact per turn; models may carry several Artefacts.

scenarios.name: Domination

deployment.description: Roll off; winner picks a side. Players alternate placing one Warband at a time wholly within 24" of their own board edge, every model within 6" of its Captain.

objectives.placement: One goes in the exact centre. Roll off; the winner places the 2nd, then players alternate the rest. Each must be at least 12" from every other objective and at least 6" from every board edge.
objectives.note: only the centre marker is fixed; the other four are player-placed

scenarios.gameEnd: Ends at the end of any turn in which an army is down to 25% or fewer of its starting models; most VP wins, equal VP is a draw.

scoring.label: Per objective: more models within 3" / at least double / only you within 3"
Enemy General wounded / slain
Enemy army Broken / Broken while yours is not

scenarios.name: Capture & Control

deployment.description: Roll off; winner picks a half. Deployment zones are each player's half of the board. For each Warband placed, roll a D6: on 1-3 it must be wholly within 12" of the centre line; on 4-6 it may go anywhere wholly in its own half. Never within 1" of an enemy model; every model within 6" of its Captain. Players alternate Warbands.

objectives.placement: One in the centre and one halfway between the centre and the middle of each board edge (12" from the centre, 12" from that edge).

specialRules: Controlling Objectives: all start neutral. In each End Phase, an objective touched (base contact) only by your models becomes yours; if both sides touch it, it goes back to neutral. Control persists otherwise.
scenarios.gameEnd: Once either army is Broken, roll a D6 at the end of every turn: on 1-2 the game ends, otherwise play another turn. Most VP wins, equal VP is a draw.

scoring.label: Each objective you control
Enemy General wounded / slain
Enemy army Broken / Broken while yours is not

objectives.placement: One 12" in from the centre of each player's board edge (inside their deployment zone); two on the centre line, each 12" from the board centre on opposite sides.
objectives.note: [24,36] is p1's own objective, [24,12] is p2's own

scenarios.gameEnd: Ends at the end of any turn in which an army is down to 25% or fewer of its starting models; most VP wins, equal VP is a draw.

scoring.label: Objective in your own zone: more models within 3"
Each centre-line objective: more models within 3" / only you within 3"

objectives.placement: None.

specialRules: A Time of Heroes

Wound Tally: count every Wound the enemy army suffers (any source, disabled Siege Engines included) plus every Fate point they spend. Wounds stopped by non-Fate means (e.g. Fury, Will used as Fate) do not count. A Hero removed with unspent Fate adds 1 per unspent point. Models fleeing a Broken army count; fleeing Mounts do not.
scenarios.gameEnd: Once either army is Broken, roll a D6 at the end of every turn: on 1-2 the game ends, otherwise play another turn. Most VP wins, equal VP is a draw.

scoring.label: Higher Wound Tally / at least double / at least triple or enemy has no models left

scenarios.name: Contest of Champions

deployment.description: Each player first names one Hero as Champion. Roll off; winner picks a half. Each Champion is placed in its own half within 3" of the board centre, then its Warband wholly in that half within 6" of the Champion; the other player does the same. Remaining Warbands alternate: roll a D6 for each, 1-3 = wholly within 12" of own edge, 4-6 = anywhere in own half. Never within 1" of an enemy; every model within 6" of its Captain.

objectives.placement: None.

specialRules: A Time of Heroes
Stand and Fight: at the start of each Move Phase the Champion with fewer kills so far may make a free Heroic Move, but must then Charge an enemy.
Only Champion kills in Combat count (not shooting, Magical Powers or Hurl Brutal Power Attack).
scenarios.gameEnd: Ends at the end of any turn in which an army is down to 25% or fewer of its starting models; most VP wins, equal VP is a draw.

scoring.label: Your Champion has more combat kills / at least 2 and double / at least 3 and triple
Your Champion kills the enemy Champion

scenarios.name: Retrieval

deployment.description: Roll off; winner picks a corner, opponent takes the opposite one. The board is split into two triangular halves along the diagonal joining the two unchosen corners; each player's half contains their corner. Warbands alternate, wholly in own half, not within 3" of the dividing diagonal, every model within 6" of its Captain.

objectives.placement: Each player places their own Relic 20" from their chosen corner along the line to the opposite corner.
objectives.note: positions assume p1 bottom-left / p2 top-right corners; first is p1's Relic

specialRules: The Relic: a Light Object. It counts as retrieved if a friendly model carries it at game end. Nobody may carry both Relics. A carrier of the enemy Relic may ignore its own. You cannot pick up your own Relic until an enemy has picked it up; if you get it back, try to return it to its start spot.
scenarios.gameEnd: Once either army is Broken, roll a D6 at the end of every turn: on 1-2 the game ends, otherwise play another turn. Most VP wins, equal VP is a draw.

objectives.placement: None; the camps (deployment areas) are the objectives.

specialRules: The Campsite: a camp is captured if at game end you have more models wholly inside the enemy camp than they do. Models inside their own camp at the start of a turn auto-pass Courage tests that turn.
